finding: BR-076 bounds a claim with ten stale leases at twenty git calls of 30 seconds each and nine waits. next-id limits every git call of a claim: git init, then fetch, rev-parse, show, mktree, commit-tree, and push per try, so the worst case is 61 calls. Count all 61, or state the bound for the twenty calls that reach the remote.
why_this_severity: Each call still stops at 30 seconds, so a claim always ends with a named cause, as QS-20 requires (no to fails_purpose); a reader who plans a timeout from the stated bound gets a third of the real worst case (raises_cost).
